parsed.name: USB4000光谱仪
parsed.description: Ocean Optics USB4000 是一款通过 USB 控制的实验室光谱仪，可设置积分时间、配置触发方式、采集光谱，并查询温度、固件版本和设备状态，常用于光谱测量与光学表征。
parsed.description_en: The Ocean Optics USB4000 is a USB-controlled laboratory spectrometer used to set integration time, configure trigger modes, acquire spectra, and query temperature, firmware version, and device status for spectroscopy and optical characterization.

actions.description: 初始化光谱仪并建立内部通信参数。
actions.description_en: Initialize the spectrometer and set up internal communication parameters.

actions.description: 设置光谱采集的积分时间（微秒）。
actions.description_en: Set the spectrometer integration time for acquisitions in microseconds.

actions.description: 查询光谱仪指定配置位置或寄存器中的值。
actions.description_en: Query the value stored at a specified spectrometer configuration position or register.

actions.description: 设置光谱采集的触发模式。
actions.description_en: Set the trigger mode for spectral acquisition.

actions.description: 请求采集并返回光谱数据。
actions.description_en: Request an acquisition and return spectral data.
